title: Residence Loading on the Flood Renewal of a Summit Reserve
content:
Flood cover on a home nobody lives in is rated differently at renewal. For a Summit Tax and Insurance Reserve under Set-Aside Accounts, the flood residence loading is read from the occupancy profile (Occupancy and Residency Certification) of the reserve's Summit loan and the loan's maturity case (Maturity and Due-and-Payable Cases).

- **Estate residence loading, 20.0 percent.** Where the occupancy profile is closed and the loan's maturity case is a Death of Last Surviving Borrower case that is due and payable or in its extension period — a home nobody lives in is rated as a non-primary residence at the next renewal.
- **Moved-out residence loading, 10.0 percent.** Where the occupancy profile shows non-occupancy confirmed — a confirmed move can still be cured by reoccupancy.
- **Otherwise** this rule adds no residence loading. A health-care absence under monitoring is not non-occupancy confirmed and does not meet either point.
